tools.name: send_postcard
tools.description: Use when someone wants a postcard made or sent from a photo. Creates an unpaid draft from one photo, with an optional note and recipient address, and returns a link to it; it never charges money or mails a postcard. The person finishes the note and address and pays on the website: $5 with postage in

tools.name: show_postcard
tools.description: Use when an existing unpaid postcard draft needs its Finish your postcard button shown. Shows that button for the draft's link. Creates nothing, and never charges money or mails a postcard.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_postcard" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "show_postcard" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
